status: draft -- S1 and S3 are declared but not yet labelled or frozen; the analyzer refuses (exit 3) until every digest is filled in
purpose: Decide whether Jev may replace or augment the entrance router, using only evidence that survives review: frozen strata, pre-declared metrics, pre-declared decision rules, and a test split that is opened once.

arms.j: Jev argmax, one choice question per case
arms.h: Jev decides when its confidence >= tau; the rule router decides below tau; tau is chosen on dev only

strata.name: s0_guard
strata.role: regression guard: must not regress; co-evolved with the rules so it cannot prove generalisation

strata.name: s0_hard
strata.role: hard cases: contract vs boundary reported separately

strata.name: s3_probe_v1
strata.role: assistant-authored probe set, kept for continuity only; excluded from the primary judgement

strata.name: s1_semantic_human
strata.role: primary: paraphrased real questions, two annotators, adjudicated

strata.name: s3_real_traffic
strata.role: primary: real question forms sampled from tickets, two annotators, adjudicated

split.rule: each primary stratum is split 50/50 by a fixed seed
split.tau_selection: dev half only; the test half is analysed once and is not used to choose tau

primary_metrics: routing accuracy per stratum against adjudicated labels
dangerous downgrade rate for complex/unsupported expectations
hybrid (arm h) accuracy at the pre-registered coverage of 90%

decision_rules.rule: dangerous downgrades must not increase versus the rule arm on any stratum
no unadjudicated regression on s0_guard or s0_hard; disagreements are adjudicated blind to arm
arm h minus arm r accuracy on s1_semantic_human union s3_real_traffic is at least +0.10, with a paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0
at 90% coverage the hybrid accuracy is higher than the rule arm
p95 latency stays at or below 2.0 s per request
provider failure or timeout degrades to the rule router with an explicit degraded marker, never silently

analysis.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar over discordant pairs
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction over the four strata
analysis.reporting: per-stratum 4x4 confusion matrices; no pooled single accuracy

budget.stop_rule: stop immediately when cumulative usage.cost reaches the cap

prohibited: changing labels after seeing model output
choosing tau on the test half
dropping a stratum that turned out badly
using the assistant-authored probe set as the primary evidence
